name: Night File
description: Quiet, uneasy, investigative. Dark 3D places with ONE light source, faceless people: witnesses are near-black with a thin red rim light, the person the story is about glows solid red. Typewriter dates and captions, evidence inserts (case files, tickets, polaroids, red circles), film grain, slow camera.
style: Dark 3D scenes, one light source, red-glowing subject
